q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit for September 2026 was a loss of ₹172,226.96 (order-date P&L lines). That loss is driven mainly by high ad spend against modest contribution margin — the P&L waterfall below reconciles exactly.

- Result: Net profit (Sep 1–30, 2026, order-date P&L) = −₹172,226.96.
- What moved it (largest lines, in order of impact):
  - Ad spend (P&L basis): −₹1,193,322.06 — the single largest negative line.
  - Contribution margin (net sales − net COGS): +₹1,021,095.09 — not enough to cover ad spend.
  - Net sales (P&L basis): +₹1,697,335.80 — built from gross sales less discounts, returns and cancels.
    - Gross sales: +₹2,253,539.40
    - Less return revenue: −₹371,999.44 and cancels −₹73,844.84 and discounts −₹110,359.32.
  - Net COGS: −₹676,240.71 (product cost ₹553,170.21 + operating cost ₹123,070.50).
  - Other operating lines: shipping −₹76,743.20; packaging −₹18,236.67; payment gateway fees −₹12,919.34; RTO −₹15,171.29.
- Why it matters: even with healthy gross sales, high returns/discounts plus large ad spend pushed the month into a loss.

Worth checking: ad spend allocation vs product-level contribution and whether return rate (₹371,999) or discounts can be reduced or targeted away from loss-making campaigns.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
